annotations.title: Open gigs an artist can apply to

description: Member-posted gigs that are OPEN FOR APPLICATIONS — real venues/promoters looking to book an act, future dates only. This is the one to use for "what can I apply for?", "any gigs for me?", "what work is going in Leeds?". Excludes the imported concert directory (see search_gigs for that) and past dates. Each row carries the gig `id` that apply_to_gig needs, and `unpaid: true` where the gig pays nothing (charity/exposure). If it returns nothing, say plainly that there are no open gigs right now — do NOT fall back to search_gigs and present concerts as opportunities.

city.description: UK city/town to filter by. Omit for national.

date_from.description: Earliest gig date, YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to today.

min_budget.description: Only gigs whose stated budget reaches this. Gigs with no budget stated are INCLUDED and flagged budget_unstated - treat those as unknown, not unpaid.
